config_name: XPS 13 — Intel Core 5 320, 8GB LPDDR5X, 256GB SSD, 13.4" 2.5K touch 120Hz (Sky)

battery.notes: Dell claims up to 17h video. Real-world light use est. ~10-12h; inferred from XPS 14 (2026) efficiency class.

price.notes: VERIFIED dell.ca 2026-11-24: $799.99 Black Friday, 'Lowest price of the year' (est. value $1,049.99). Notable value pick for a premium 13-inch.

reviews.quote: It's great to see Dell bring back the XPS and do so with such style.

praises: 1 kg / 12.7 mm chassis — the thinnest, lightest XPS yet per dell.ca; genuinely pocketable
13.4" 2.5K 120Hz touch panel at 500 nits is far better than any other sub-$900 Windows laptop
Black Friday deal makes it lowest-price-of-the-year for a CNC aluminum + Gorilla Glass premium chassis
Silent fanless-like behavior in light office work on the 6-core Core 5 320
Thunderbolt 4 x2 with 500-nit panel covers docking and outdoor use despite the low price
complaints: 8GB soldered RAM is a hard ceiling — no upgrade path and it will bottleneck multitasking within a year or two
256GB soldered storage fills up fast with Windows updates and OneDrive caches
Core 5 320 (no Ultra branding) lacks the Copilot+ NPU tier of the Ultra 7 models
Only 2 USB-C ports and no USB-A/HDMI — dongles mandatory
Dell after-sales support frustration is a recurring theme across XPS owner threads

design_philosophy: Dell's 2026 XPS revival doubles down on extreme thinness and edge-to-edge minimalism: a 1 kg CNC-aluminum slab with Gorilla Glass palmrest and near-invisible design seams. This entry tier trades RAM and storage for the same chassis and 120Hz touch display as the higher tiers.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from CNET's XPS 14 (2026, DA14260) review (8.1/10) plus dell.ca specs — no direct pro review found for the DX13260 Core 5 tier. Smaller/weaker Core 5 320 + 8GB RAM: productivity −2.5 vs reviewed XPS 14 config, gaming −0.7, portability +1.5 (1.0 kg vs 1.36 kg), battery +0.5 (smaller screen, weaker chip). screen_quality 8.0 for 2.5K 500-nit IPS touch (no OLED contrast).
omitted_note: Also sold: Core 5 320 / 16GB / 512GB at CAD $1,249.99 (verified) — consolidated here for brevity.
